about.description: VEDA Indian Cuisine & Bar offers authentic Indian dishes including tandoori specialties, curries, breads, and traditional appetizers.

menu.name: RAITA
menu.description: Chilled yogurt mixed with fresh vegetables, seasoned with cumin and coriander. A cool, tangy side dish that complements spicier meals.

menu.name: ACHAR
menu.description: Tangy and spicy Indian pickle made with mixed vegetables or fruits, preserved in mustard oil and traditional spices. A flavorful side that adds a zesty kick to any meal.

menu.name: VEG SAMOSA (2 PCS)
menu.description: Crispy, golden pastries stuffed with a flavorful mix of spiced potatoes, peas, and herbs. These classic Indian snacks are served in pairs and are perfect with a side of mint chutney.

menu.name: HARA BHARA KABAB (6 PCS)
menu.description: A vibrant blend of spinach, peas, and aromatic spices, these golden, pan-fried kebabs are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. A healthy yet indulgent appetizer, served with a tangy mint chutney to complement the fresh, herbaceous flavors.

menu.name: PANEER PAKODA
menu.description: Crispy, golden fritters made from cubes of paneer, dipped in a seasoned gram flour batter, and deep-fried to perfection. These bite-sized treats are crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside, and served with a tangy chutney.

menu.name: VEG PAKODA
menu.description: Golden, crispy fritters made from a mix of fresh vegetables, gram flour, and spices, deep-fried to perfection. Served with tangy chutney, these crispy treats are perfect as a snack or appetizer.

menu.name: ASSORTED VEG
menu.description: A delightful vegetarian platter featuring a variety of favorites: crisp samosas filled with spiced potatoes, golden paneer pakoras, masala-seasoned fries, and mixed vegetable pakoras. Perfect for sharing or enjoying as an appetizer.

menu.name: GOBI 65
menu.description: Crispy, golden-fried cauliflower florets tossed in a fiery South Indian spice blend, curry leaves, and garlic. This bold and flavorful appetizer is crunchy on the outside, tender inside, and perfect with a squeeze of lemon.

menu.name: PANEER HARIYALI
menu.description: Paneer cubes marinated in a fragrant green paste of spinach, coriander, and mint, grilled until smoky and charred. The green marinade gives this dish a fresh, herbaceous flavor that pairs wonderfully with its smoky grilled texture.
